notes.title: Roulette Hero Playtest is Live for a Limited Time!
notes.notes:
[i]Welcome to the Commencement
> Detecting "Hero" signal input...
> Generating announcement message...[/i]

Dear Hero,

Congratulations! You have been selected as the lucky first batch of players to experience Roulette Hero!
The playtest will be live until 16 May 2025, 2AM PST, and we warmly welcome you to give our game a spin!
[strike]Quite the surprise that you were chosen, but oh well, that is what the system has decided using its exceedingly fair judgement and it is never wrong.[/strike]

Now, allow me to introduce this game to you:
First, you must assemble your animal companions. No need to fear your enemies! They may towering mechanical beasts made of unbreakable steel, but you and your animal companions have the power of friendship [strike]and each animal's unique abilities[/strike], do you not?
Next, position your animal companions to maximize their abilities upon the roulette wheel. Don't say I didn't warn you if your animals lack synergy with their neighbors.
Then — here comes the best part — pull that lever and watch that roulette spin! Will you land a killer combo? Or a game-breaking chain effect? 

The system has even prepared an onboarding video for you. [strike]Aren't we just the nicest ever?[/strike]

[previewyoutube=EF4ZyN48p9Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Oh, you're still here?
What are you waiting for? Play Roulette Hero now! And don't forget to add us to your wishlist because there is even more game updates to come!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3371510/_/

This game is still an early build and bugs are to be expected. We greatly value your feedback and suggestions so we would appreciate it if you filled up our feedback form [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1TQ0hcTxr6Fl_s6NwsK5CwkiJCdKvLSj2DXU9BDh3-PE/edit]HERE[/url].
